M1_ome_evidence_to_action.note: at/under 40 dB the response is near chance -- an action there is barely justified by the stimulus; the justification floor sits at the real threshold (~loud for P=0.75).

M2_sleepstudy_motor_timing.note: A pushed action has a timing fingerprint. Real reaction times essentially never fall below the per-subject readiness band; an injected automatic push (RT < sensorimotor floor) is flagged almost always. RT-plausibility is a motor justification axis the content-only monitor does not have.

M3_fishing_selection.abstain_note: price/catch alone barely beat always-charter, so the justification model cannot reliably say which choices are unjustified; the guardian abstains rather than police selections on a weak model. This is the correct outcome.

injected_override_recovery.note: floor still beats the count cap, but the weak model limits the gain -- consistent with the abstain call.
